dialogues.speaker: Tezozo
dialogues.text: Should I go ask Xipilli for some more...

dialogues.speaker: Tezozo
dialogues.text: Handicraft material, of course! Xipilli's awesome at that stuff, and I'd love to learn the art too.

dialogues.speaker: Tezozo
dialogues.text: But he gave me all sorts of strange materials, telling me that "it's more interesting if I found my own way to put things together."

dialogues.speaker: Tezozo
dialogues.text: And yeah, it's been an interesting time, but I've just got too many ideas, and use too much material... I lose some at times, too...

dialogues.speaker: Tezozo
dialogues.text: Before I knew it, this is all I was left with...

dialogues.speaker: Tezozo
dialogues.text: Uh, sure. Guess I should try other materials...

dialogues.speaker: Tezozo
dialogues.text: We should make the most of what we have before considering anything else.

dialogues.speaker: Tezozo
dialogues.text: It's said these are fruits grown from liquid Phlogiston... Hmm, I don't think I can use them properly for now...

dialogues.speaker: Tezozo
dialogues.text: So, you take them — remember to put 'em to good use.
